Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Are you open on Saturdays? And can I use insurance?

Yes, we are open on Saturdays from nine in the morning until seven in the evening. As for insurance, whether it can be used depends on the type of injury and your situation. Our staff can explain the details when you visit. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
